title: Triage + gate one pilot open PRIDE cancer DDA dataset
context: M1 requires one approved open PRIDE cancer DDA dataset as its starting point. Before any data is downloaded, the dataset must pass the allow-list gate defined in allowlist-002 and the re-identification policy from reid-policy-006, reviewed and approved by the License+Compliance reviewer. The gate produces a committed PASS artifact per dataset. Without this gate, the pipeline task (pilot-009) cannot legally start. Dataset selection must also be sized to fit donated-session budgets.
objective: Select and run one pilot open PRIDE cancer DDA dataset through the full allow-list compliance gate, producing a committed PASS artifact that authorizes pilot-009 to begin processing.
acceptanceCriteria: A public PRIDE/ProteomeXchange cancer DDA dataset is selected that is sized to fit donated-session budgets (e.g., manageable raw file count/size for a single session).

The dataset passes the allow-list gate with a committed PASS artifact: accessClass=open established from a cited source statement, license verified and snapshotted (SHA-256 + archived URL) for the specific accession, PII determination recorded, and re-identification determination recorded (variant identity default-denied per reid-policy-006).
The dataset is confirmed not controlled-access and not identifiable; dbGaP/EGA/biobank/individual-level data is hard-rejected if proposed.
COSMIC/OncoKB are noted as not to be embedded in any outputs from this dataset.
The PASS artifact is committed to datasets/allowlist.yml (or equivalent) and reviewed/approved by the License+Compliance reviewer before pilot-009 begins.
